span.p: TRAINING EFFICIENCY

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MUON optimizer
~2x compute efficiency vs AdamW, ~52 pct of FLOPs
~33 pct memory saving. Validated on an MoE model at
scale (Moonlight 3B/16B) and in production (Kimi K2).
CAVEAT: fewer steps but costlier steps (Newton-Schulz
is cubic) - must be benchmarked on our shapes.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STRUCTURE CONTRIBUTES MORE THAN SEQUENCE.
A table captures under half the signal, and covers
only 86.7 pct of steps - the unusual ones get nothing.
Same lesson as the GNRA negative result.

103,964 annotated steps, 155 of 180 structures

span.p:
_pdbx_unobs_or_zero_occ_residues
46,447 RNA unmodelled residues
(143,871 raw rows, but 67.5 pct are protein)

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
VALIDATION - step means reproduce A-form RNA
GG/CC rise 3.14 twist 29.98 slide -1.69
AU/AU rise 2.81 twist 33.94 slide -1.58
reference: rise 2.8-3.1 A, twist ~32 deg, slide ~-1.5 A

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MEASURED STIFFNESS F = kT C^-1
76 contexts with n >= 200
spans 115x in twist force constant: UG/UG sd 11.5 deg (stiffest)
to AA/UA 102 deg (floppiest, non-canonical)
GC content predicts rigidity: pearson -0.314

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
STIFFNESS ENCODER (replaces the table)
in: trunk repr + pair repr at each step
out: mu in R^6 and 6x6 precision F, Cholesky-parameterised
so positive-definiteness is structural

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
L_stiff = sum 0.5 (x-mu)^T F (x-mu) - 0.5 log det F
the log-det term is LOAD-BEARING: without it the
degenerate optimum is F -> 0, declare everything
floppy and pay nothing. Confidence must be earned.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ACCEPTANCE CRITERION
must beat 14.551 nats/step on held-out structures.
above 17.579 it is worse than a table - CUT IT.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: E_rigid in the Hamiltonian

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FULL OBJECTIVE
L = L_MLM + L_2D + L_contact + L_dist
+ L_stiff + L_Mg + L_elec + L_violation + L_flex
precedent: OpenMM-Loss puts MD potential energy into
AlphaFold2 and gets comparable accuracy with LOWER
energy and better MolProbity. Physics helps quality
without costing accuracy.
